```yaml
name: Build and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CI: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint source code
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Build plugins
        run: bash scripts/build-plugins.sh

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload built plugins
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-plugins
          path: plugins/**

      - name: Upload test coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage/*.xml
          flags: unittests
```
